scope: Bounded engineering suitability comparison after initial favorable listening; no sound tuning, engine selection, new preset or private rerender
workload: Fixed generated mono harmonic E2/A3/C6, noise/consonant-like interval, intentional bend and low-register ending; 5 seconds primary plus 0.6 supplied zero tail. Never reads an input audio file.
musical: Scale C major, three voices, unchanged lead, native consonants/formant preservation, +/-12 guard, inactive uncertain targets and fixed 100ms reserve. Voicings: third/fifth/octave at 0s; -octave/unity/+octave at 1.6s; lower third/fifth/-octave at 2.8s; initial voicing restored at 4s.
cpu: Optimized unsanitized audited Release only, sequential runs without concurrent qualification builds/profilers/sanitizers. Native callback time includes actual shared tracker/selector, three engines, bounded adaptation, hash/audit and preallocated output capture; telemetry consumer/file work excluded. Retain all cold/steady callbacks, nearest-rank p99.9, max and overdue count, not a Logic/hardware deadline guarantee.
lifecycle: Finalize, assert restart rejection, stopped graph reconstruction (not native engine.reset), then identical eventful workload; independently fresh graph after prior workloads. Record stopped allocations/cost separately; they are not allowed inside a callback. No warm/prime workaround.
repeatability: Compare all ten raw channels and exact input/control hashes: cold vs reconstructed, cold vs warm-fresh, reconstructed vs warm-fresh, and cold captures across two independent processes. Fixed max_abs 1e-6 and RMS 1e-7, exact lengths; retain every failed channel.
partition_comparison: Also compare first-process cold captures at 128 versus 512 callbacks for each engine/rate; no additional renders or retuning
not_established: audio-thread reset/state handoff or host seek behavior
privacy: No private recording or derivative audio input, clip c, holdout or playback. Existing private metadata may be reviewed only inside ignored evaluation; public results here are newly generated synthetic evidence.
stop: One fixed comparison, no corrective tuning loop. Candidate technical failures stay failed. Recommend next verification subject to user authorization; no AU integration or automatic clip-c approval.
